title: App Store screenshots S-V1: colour campaign
brief: Six App Store screenshots (iPhone 6.9", 1320 × 2868 PNG) to replace the raw full-screen set, built on the founder's 7 principles (Scrnsht Studio): screen 1 = the value prop, sell the outcome, one message per screenshot, the idea readable without the words, a real person in it, honest trust signals only, short oversized headlines. The colourful header's world (A2): lit colour fields from Emma's own photos, her photos as prints, her real wardrobe cut-outs with real shadows, the real build-284 screens in Apple's bezel, Geist Medium. 1 Always know what to wear · 2 Your closet, from your photos · 3 See it on you · 4 A look for every day · 5 Ask your stylist · 6 Your photos, your call.
hook: Screenshot 1, seen small in search: her, dressed, beside the app showing that same look; the headline readable at 25%.
